[
مُطَرِّدٌ , accord. to Freytag, occurs in the Deewán of the Hudhalees, applied to a spear, as meaning Altogether straight, so that the whole trembles:
for that which is crooked does not. But this, if not a mistranscription, is app. used by poetic license, for ↓ مُطَّرِدٌ .]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
